listing.name: Library Of Ruina Theme Ui
listing.summary: So it's a Library Of Ruina Theme Ui Pack, I use icons and frame stuff in LOR to replace the the vanilla UI, and I made the color gold and black to imitate the library invitation
listing.aiSummary: Replaces the vanilla user interface with icons and frames styled after Library of Ruina.

description:
Sth I made it in the CN sector 2 months ago, after fixing and testing I decided to upload it here
So it's a Library Of Ruina Theme Ui Pack, I use icons and frame stuff in LOR to replace the the vanilla UI, and I made the color gold and black to imitate the library invitation

Spoiler

Yeah I'm out of idea what for energy damage so I used dodge

No Requirements since it's just a resource replace mod(you do need do sth to have same starting page as I do(java 23/24 doesn't apply cause Miko made his own starting page)
Download

aiDescription: Replaces the vanilla user interface with icons and frames styled after Library of Ruina. Uses a gold and black color scheme to imitate the library invitation from the source game.

gallery.aiCaption: Starsector logo with a decorative gold bar underneath.
Main menu screen featuring Library of Ruina style UI elements and a 'Play Starsector' button.
Loading screen with a decorative gold bar and text instructions.
Crew and Cargo interface showing inventory slots and character stats.
Star map view with a sensor burst circle and system navigation UI.
Ship refit screen showing the ISS Red Dwarf ship sprite and status bars.
Weapon details screen for 'Vulcan Cannon' with stats and a flame icon.
Weapon details screen for 'Railgun' with stats and an orange projectile icon.
Weapon details screen for 'Light Assault Gun' with stats and a flame icon.
Weapon details screen for 'PD Laser' with stats and a blue energy icon.
